content:
### Why Most SIT™ Partners Start With a Visibility Pilot

A common question from contractorsevaluating SIT GroundForce™ why is there a Pilot phase rather than movingdirectly into a full territory partnership?

The answer is straight forward: territory commitments are structural. Once a trade category is approved in a defined area, it is closed to other partners. That exclusivity has real value —and it requires a real evaluation to protect it.

###  What the Visibility Pilot Actually Is

The Visibility Pilot is a structured evaluation phase — not a trial run and not a watered-down version of the full program. It confirms territory fit and introduces neighborhood presence before full partnership access opens.

During the Pilot phase, structured outreach is introduced in the territory. Homeowner interactions establish initial brand familiarity. Territory alignment is confirmed based on geographic coverage and industry category fit.

###  What Happens After the Pilot

Contractors who complete the Pilot and confirm territory fit move into a full Strategic Industry Territory partnership — with continued structured outreach in their defined area and full exclusivity protections of the SIT™ program. The Pilot is the door to the partnership. Not a separate program.

###  The Priority Territory Review Option

Contractors who want to confirm territory availability faster can optionally request a Priority Territory Review — evaluated within 48 hours, includes a Territory Availability Summary for your specific trade and area. Fully refunded if your territory is unavailable or fit is not confirmed.
